topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Well, now, Master John's found himself a secret no one else could lay claim to. A hidden room, they say, within the old walls of his new home. I reckon it's the sort of thing that makes a man feel closer to the earth, like finding a seed you didn't know you planted. Took some good, honest work to uncover it, too. I remember telling him, when he bought the place, that the old manor had stories to tell. Guess he’s proved me right. Folks around here might gossip, but I see it as a sign of cleverness and a bit of fortune. Who knows what treasures or secrets he might find? Bet it'll make his name ring out in the village for a good while.
